Messages.Author: Emilio
Messages.Body:
This is a question about Obedience and Psiche.

It is xtrange and weird, but in the last Tournament in MAdird, the
following situation appeared:

Vamp A bumrush vamp B(older and tapped).
Situation: action being performed...succesfull(no one play mods or
reacts).
Vamp A strikes hand, and B strikes CE and untap.
Situation: combat finished and both vampires ready.
Vamp A plays psiche!.
Situation: About to enter combat betwen a vampire and a reacting,
untapped and older vampire.
Vamp B plays Obedience.
Situation: 2nd combat does not occur. so situation is the former one:
Combat finished and both vampires ready.

Can vampire A play another Psiche!?

This is all.
BAsa.
